concept: The sections of a long page as links, the one in view raised as the chosen pane and set semibold, the same mark as Sidebar.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a list of grey links with a blue active link (docs table of contents)
default_to_avoid.kind: table of contents, on this page, anchor navigation, toc
default_to_avoid.why_not: blue is a hue; grey alone does not say where the reader is

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the section in view is semibold with a lit line, a mark and a weight

derivation.consequence: one solid fill exists, the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light); a promoted action is the same solid glowing with its own light, and a pane uses one of them
derivation.form: the lit line is the loud solid, the one mark in the list

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: a link moves focus to its heading as well as scrolling

variants.options: ['A lit line and weight', 'B blue active link', 'C numbered list', 'D chosen pane and weight']
variants.reason: D marks by shape and weight with the same chosen pane as Sidebar. A is the habitual accent stripe (G-X1). B brings blue. C adds numbers the sections do not have.

root.why: the title and the links, the same in every theme and on every scene

title.why: the list’s name in the micro caps, the same in every theme and on every scene

list.why: the links in a plain column with no rail, the same in every theme and every scene

link.why: a section link in the label size, the same in every theme and on every scene

sub.why: a sub-section, indented one step, the same in every theme and on every scene

hover.why: a link darkens under the pointer, the same in every theme and on every scene

aria-current=location.why: the section in view is raised as Sidebar’s chosen pane and set semibold, a shape and a weight

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring, the same in every theme and on every scene

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours outline the section in view in the highlight colour
